metadata.description: Headless Skia Canvas rasterization pipeline, subpixel precision, node drawing, multi-scale export, and Porter-Duff compositing

pipeline_phases.phase: SKCanvas instantiated at (W * S, H * S) with scale multiplier S (@1x - @4x)
ctx.scale(S, S) maps logical coords to device pixels
Depth-first traversal ordered by calculated z-index and DOM sequence
Isolated ctx.save() / ctx.restore() transactions per node

subpixel_snapping.fills: Snapped to full integer pixel boundaries (Math.round)
subpixel_snapping.strokes: Center coordinate adjusted by +0.5px when stroke-width is 1px for crisp pixel boundary alignment

node_rendering.shapes: Transform pivot, clipping, drop shadows before draw, fill path, stroke path with lineCap/lineJoin
node_rendering.text: GlobalFonts registration, alphabetic baseline calculation (y_baseline = y_box + valignShift + ascent), sequential line wrapping
node_rendering.images: Skia native codecs with bilinear/bicubic filtering; object-fit: cover | contain | fill

multi_scale_export.description: Glyph vectors render at native N-x resolution without bitmap upsampling artifacts.
